verses.sanskrit:
सौतिरुवाच।
              एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु जरत्कारुर्महातपाः। चचार पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां यत्रसायंगृहो मुनिः॥१॥
verses.english: Sauti said: About this time, the great ascetic Jaratkaru, becoming a Yatra-Sayan Griha, roamed over the world.
verses.bhavadeepa: वरं वरणीयम् । प्रतीतरूपा हृष्टरूपा । प्रतीतं प्रख्यातं रूपं सौन्दर्यं यस्या इति वा । भावेनानुरागातिशयेन । ‘अनुभूतमिहाकूतं मृगयापदमापदाम् । विष्णुरातोऽपियद्रागादगात्तक्षकभक्ष्यताम्’ इति रत्नगर्भः ॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: चरन्दीक्षां महातेजा दुश्चराम कृतात्मभिः। तीर्थेष्वाप्लवनं कुत्वा पुण्येषु विचचार ह॥२॥
verses.english: The greatly powerful Rishi roamed about, bathing in various sacred waters and practising various vows, difficult to be practised by others.

verses.sanskrit: वायुभक्षो निराहारः शुष्यन्नहरहर्मुनिः। सं ददर्श पितॄन्गर्ते लम्बमानानधोमुखान्॥३॥
verses.english: The Rishi lived on air and was completely free from all worldly desires, thus becoming daily lean and emaciated. Thus did he see his ancestors, hanging in the hole, their heads downwards.

verses.sanskrit: एकतन्त्ववशिष्टं वै वीरणस्तम्बमाश्रितान्। तं तन्तुं च शनैराखुमाददानं बिलेशयम्॥४॥
verses.english: By a cord of Virana roots, having only one thread entire. Even that one thread was gradually being eaten away by the rat, living in that hole.

verses.sanskrit: निराहारान्कृशान्दीनान्गर्ते स्वत्राणमिच्छतः। उपसृत्य स तान्दीनान्दीनरूपोऽभ्यभाषत॥५॥
verses.english: They were in the hole without food; they were emaciated, pitiable and eagerly desirous of emancipation. Jaratkaru, in humble guise, came near these pitiable ones and asked them,

verses.sanskrit: के भवन्तोऽवलम्बन्ते वीरमस्तम्बमाश्रिताः। दुर्बलं खादितैर्मूलैराखुना बिलवासिना॥६॥
verses.english: "Who are you that are hanging by the cord of Virana roots, of which the single weak root that is still left is gradually being eaten away by the rat that lives in this hole.

verses.sanskrit: वीरणस्तम्बके मूलं यदप्येकमिह स्थितम्। तदप्ययं शनैराखुरादत्ते दशनैः शितैः॥७॥
छेत्स्यतेऽल्पावशिष्टत्वादेतदप्यचिरादिव। ततस्तु पतितारोऽत्र गर्ते व्यक्तमधोमुखाः॥८॥
verses.english: The little that remains of the single thread will soon be cut away, It is quite evident that you will then fall into the pit with your heads downwards.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य मे दुःखमुत्पन्नं दृष्ट्वा युष्मानधोमुखान्। कृच्छ्रामापदमापन्नान्प्रियं किं करवाणि वः॥९॥
verses.english: I have been moved with pity, seeing that you hang with your faces downwards and that you are overtaken by a great calamity. What good can I do to you?

verses.sanskrit: तपसोऽस्य चतुर्थेन तृतीयेनाथवा पुनः। अर्धेन वापि निस्तर्तुमापदं ब्रूत मा चिरम्॥१०॥
verses.english: Tell me without delay whatever your this great calamity can be relived with a fourth, or a third or even a half of my this asceticism.
verses.bhavadeepa: कृच्छ्रं दुस्तरं यथा स्यात्तथा । आपदम् आपन्नान्प्राप्तान् ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: अथवापि समग्रेण तरन्तु तपसा मम। भवन्तः सर्व एवेह काममेवं विधीयताम्॥११॥
verses.english: O relieve yourselves even with the whole of my asceticism. I consent to it. Do as you please.

verses.sanskrit:
पितर ऊचुः।
              वृद्धो भवान्ब्रह्मचारी यो न स्त्रातुमिहेच्छसि। न तु विप्राग्र्यतपसा शक्यमेतद्व्यपोहितुम्॥१२॥
verses.english: The Ancestors said: O Venerable Brahmachari, you wish to relieve us. But, O best of the twice-bom, you cannot relieve us with your asceticism.

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति नस्तात तपसः फलं प्रवदतां वर। संतानप्रक्षयाद्ब्रह्मन्पतामो निरये शुचौ॥१३॥
verses.english: O child, O best of speakers, we have also the fruits of our asceticism, but O Brahmana, we are falling down into this hell for the want of offspring.

verses.sanskrit: सन्तानं हि परो धर्म एवमाह पितामहः। लम्बतामिह नस्तात न ज्ञानं प्रतिभाति वै॥१४॥
verses.english: The Grandsire has said, 'the offspring is the great Dharma.' O child, hanging as we are in this hole, our intellect has grown dim.

verses.sanskrit: येन त्वां नाभिजानीमो लोके विख्यातपौरुषम्। वृद्धो भवान्महाभागो यो नः शोच्यान्सुदुःखितान्॥१५॥
verses.english: Therefore we cannot know you, although you are known for your greatness all over the world. You are venerable, you are of good fortune, you sorrowfully grieve for us.
verses.bhavadeepa: ज्ञानं संज्ञा यया संज्ञया त्वां जानीमः मूर्च्छितकल्पाः स्म इत्यर्थः ॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: शोचते चैव कारुण्याच्छ्रुणु ये वै वयं द्विज। यायावरा नाम वयमृषयः संशितव्रताः॥१६॥
verses.english: Hear, O Brahmana, who we are and for whom you are lamenting. We are Rishis of the name of Yayavara of rigid vows.

verses.sanskrit: लोकात्पुम्यादिह भ्रष्टाः सन्तानप्रक्षयान्मुने। प्रणष्टं नस्तपस्तीव्रं न हि नस्तन्तुरस्ति वै॥१७॥
verses.english: O Rishi, we have fallen from a holy region for want of offspring. Our great penances have not been destroyed, therefore, we have still one cord left (to hang from.)

verses.sanskrit: अस्तित्वेकोऽद्य नस्तन्तुः सोऽपि नास्ति यथा तथा। मन्दभाग्योऽल्पभाग्यानां तप एकं समास्थितः॥१८॥
verses.english: We have only one thread (son) now, but it matters little whether he is or he is not. Unfortunate we are! We have a thread in one, known as Jaratkaru, well-read in the Vedas and Vedangas, who has adopted asceticism. He is high-souled, he has his senses under complete control, he is a man of rigid vows, a great ascetic.

verses.sanskrit: जरत्कारुरिति ख्यातो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः। नियतात्मा महात्मा च सुव्रतः सुमहातपाः॥१९॥
तेन स्म तपसो लोभात्कृच्छ्रमापादिता वयम्। न तस्य भार्या पुत्रो वा बान्धवो वाऽस्ति कश्चन॥२०॥
verses.english: But from his temptation for the merits of asceticism we have been reduced to this state. He was no wife and no son, no friend, no relatives.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माल्लम्बामहे गर्ते नष्टसंज्ञा ह्यनाथवत्। स वक्तव्यस्त्वया दृष्टो ह्यस्माकं नाथवत्तया॥२१॥
verses.english: This is the reason why we hang in this hole, our consciousness gone, like one having no one to look after. If you meet him, tell him out of kindness for us,

verses.sanskrit: पितरस्तेऽवलम्बन्ते गर्ते दीना अधोमुखाः। साधु दारान्कुरुष्वेति प्रजामुत्पादयेति च॥२२॥
verses.english: “Your ancestors are hanging in grief with their faces downwards. O holy man, take a wife and beget offspring.

verses.sanskrit: कुलतन्तुर्हि नः शिष्टः स एकैकस्तपोधन। यस्त्वं पश्यसि नो ब्रह्मन्वीरणस्तम्बमाश्रतान्॥२३॥
verses.english: O Rishi, O holy man, you are the only thread in the line of your ancestors.” O Brahmana, the Virana root that you see and on which we hang,

verses.sanskrit: एषोऽस्माकं कुलस्तम्ब आस्ते स्वकुलवर्धनः। यानि पश्यसि वै ब्रह्मन्मूलानीहास्य वीरुधः॥२४॥
verses.english: Is the cord representing our race. O Brahmana, these threads of the Virana roots which you see eaten up (by the rat) are we ourselves, who have been eaten up by Time. This root which you see half eaten,

verses.sanskrit: एते नस्तन्तवस्तात कालेन परिभक्षिताः। यत्त्वेतत्पश्यसि ब्रह्मन्मूलमस्यार्धभक्षितम्॥२५॥
यत्र लम्बामहे गर्ते सोऽप्येकस्तप आस्थितः। यमाखुं पश्यसि ब्रह्मन्काल एष महाबलः॥२६॥
verses.english: And by which we are hanging in this hole is he who has adopted asceticism. The rat which you see is Time of infinite strength.

verses.sanskrit: स तं तपोरतं मन्दं शनैः क्षपयते तुदन्। जरत्कारुं तपोलुब्धं मन्दात्मानमचेतसम्॥२७॥
verses.english: He (Time) is slowly killing the wretch Jaratkaru, engaged in asceticism, having been tempted by its merits but wanting in prudence and heart.

verses.sanskrit: न हि नस्तत्तपस्तस्य तारयिष्यति सत्तम। छिन्नमूलान्परिभ्रष्टान्कालोपहतचेतसः॥२८॥
verses.english: O excellent one, his asceticism cannot save us. The roots being torn, falling off from heavens, deprived of consciousness by Time.

verses.sanskrit: अधः प्रविष्टान्पश्यास्मान्यथा दुष्कृतिनस्तथा। अस्मासु पतितेष्वत्र सह सर्वैः सबान्धवैः॥२९॥
verses.english: Behold like sinful wretches we are going downwards. On our going with all our relatives down into this hole,

verses.sanskrit: छिन्नः कालेन सोऽप्यत्र गन्ता वै नरकं ततः। तपोऽवाप्यथ यज्ञो यच्चान्यत्पावनं महत्॥३०॥
verses.english: Eaten up by Time, he too will sink with us into hell. Whether it is asceticism, or sacrifice, or other holy acts,

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वं न समं तात संतत्येति सतां मतम्। स तात दृष्ट्वा ब्रूयास्तं जरत्कारुं तपोधन॥३१॥
verses.english: O child, they are inferior and cannot be equal to a son. O child, seeing all this, tell every thing to the Rishi Jaratkaru.

verses.sanskrit: यथा दृष्टमिदं चात्र त्वयाऽऽख्येयमशेषतः। यथा दारान्प्रकुर्यात्स पुत्रानुत्पादयेद्यथा॥३२॥
verses.english: O Brahmana, becoming our saviour, you should, out of kindness towards us, tell him in detail all that you have seen, so that it might induce him to take a wife and beget offspring.
verses.bhavadeepa: अपरं ज्ञानादर्वाचीनम् । ‘किं प्रजया करिष्यामो येषां नोऽयमात्मायं लोकः’ इति श्रुतेः । ‘किमर्थावयमध्येष्यामहे किमर्थावयं यक्ष्यामहे वाचि हि प्राणं जुहुमः’ इत्यादि श्रुतेश्च पित्राद्यृणमज्ञानमेवेति भाव ॥३१॥

verses.sanskrit: वा ब्रह्मंस्त्वया वाच्यः सोऽस्माकं नाथवत्तया। बान्धवानां हितस्येह यथा चात्मकुलं तथा॥३३॥
verses.english: O excellent man, who are you? You niay be one of his friends, for you grieve for us like a friend and as one belonging to our race. We wish to hear who you are that stand before us.

verses.sanskrit: कस्त्वं बन्धुमिवास्माकमनुशोचसि सत्तम। श्रोतुमिच्छाम सर्वेषां को भवानिह तिष्ठति॥३४॥
verses.bhavadeepa: बान्धवानामित्यादिसार्धः श्लोकः । तस्य बान्धवानाम् अस्माकं सर्वेषां मध्ये कस्त्वम् । यथा आत्मकुलं तथा बन्धुमिव वा अस्मान् अनुशोचसि तत्तस्माच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामः को भवानिह तिष्ठतीति योजना ॥३३॥
